title: The Wedding at Cana

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A few days later, Jesus and His disciples went to a wedding in the village of Cana.

bsb: Woman, why does this concern us?
My hour has not yet come.
kjv: Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.
Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.

puzzle.prompt: What did Mary tell the servants?

choices.text: Ask the master of the banquet

puzzle.hint: Mary trusted Jesus. Listen to what she said.

bsb: So they filled them to the brim.
kjv: And they filled them up to the brim.

bsb: and take it to the master of the banquet.
kjv: Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast.

bsb: Everyone serves the fine wine first, and then the cheap wine after the guests are drunk. But you have saved the fine wine until now!
kjv: Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now.

puzzles.prompt: Jesus told the servants to fill the stone water jars.
puzzles.question: How many stone water jars were there?
puzzles.hint: Count the jars again, one at a time.
Jesus showed who He really is.

bsb: He thus revealed His glory, and His disciples believed in Him.
kjv: and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.

bsb: Jesus performed this, the first of His signs, at Cana in Galilee. He thus revealed His glory, and His disciples believed in Him.
kjv: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.

reflect: Mary told the servants, “Do whatever He tells you.” We can trust Jesus the same way.
discuss: Why do you think Jesus' first sign was at a wedding, a happy family celebration?
Mary didn't know exactly what Jesus would do, but she trusted Him. When is it hard for you to trust Jesus?
How did this sign help the disciples believe?
prayer: Dear Jesus, thank You that You care about our families and our happy days. Help us do whatever You tell us. Amen.
